title: Change One Thing at a Time
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：result　|　正文 393 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 result 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In the spring of my second year our biology teacher gave us a question rather than an experiment: do beans grow faster in warm soil or in cool? We wrote a hypothesis down, then discovered we had no idea how to test it. Our first attempt ① resulted in eleven dead seedlings and one very damp cupboard.

② As a result of that failure we rewrote everything: same tray, same water, same light, and only the temperature changed. That single rule — change one thing at a time — is the whole of science, and it took us a week to invent it for ourselves. Nobody had told us; everybody assumed we already knew. The second set of ③ results was so regular that our teacher asked, kindly, whether we had invented them.

Some failures ④ result from bad luck and some from tampering with the data, but most ⑤ result from bad design, and ours was the second kind. We had watered with a kettle, and the kettle was warm one day and cold the next. ⑥ As a result nothing else we did meant anything, because two variables had moved at once, and no honest evidence can come out of that.

That spring our results were read by two teachers before anybody trusted them. By May we had forty trays and a habit of recording everything twice: once in the notebook, once on the blackboard. Our final ⑦ result was modest — warm soil about eleven per cent faster — and could probably have been looked up in a book in ten minutes. No result, her assistant said, is worth much until somebody else can repeat it. What could not be looked up anywhere was the discipline of asking one question at a time and then writing the answer down honestly.

Two things have stayed with me. First, the ⑧ result itself is rarely the interesting part; the interesting part is what you had to change in yourself to obtain one. Second, nobody ever told us that being wrong eleven times is the ordinary sequence of being curious. Our project came fourth in the science fair, and the ⑨ results stayed pinned to the notice board for exactly one week. Six weeks of work finished, ⑩ with the result that we produced exactly one sentence for the school magazine. That single sentence, I think, was the point of the whole exercise.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （实验、测量的）数据；一组结果
C. n. （比赛、评选的）成绩；名次
D. v. 起因于；由……造成（result from）
E. v. 导致；造成（result in）
F. 固定搭配：as a result 因此
G. 固定搭配：as a result of 由于
H. 固定搭配：with the result that 结果是；致使

items.q: Our first attempt resulted in eleven dead seedlings
As a result of that failure we rewrote everything
The second set of results was so regular
Some failures result from bad luck
As a result nothing else we did meant anything
the result itself is rarely the interesting part
the results stayed pinned to the notice board
with the result that we produced exactly one sentence

answers.why: result in＋坏结果，是动词“导致”，第一次尝试导致十一株幼苗死亡。
as a result of＋名词，意为“由于”，说明因为失败才重写方案。
a set of results 指实验得出的一整组“数据、结果”。
result from＋原因，意为“起因于”，有些失败源于运气不好。
同样是 result from，说明大多数失败源于设计不当，与第 4 题构成正反对照。
as a result 位于句首，意为“因此”，说明同时改变两个变量导致全部无效。
our final result 指最终得到的“结论、结果”（暖土约快百分之十一）。
the result itself 同样指结果本身，作者说结果往往不是最有趣的部分。
科技节评比张贴的 results 指“成绩、名次”，此处为比赛结果的公布。
with the result that＋从句，意为“结果是……”，引出六周工作的唯一产物。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我们的第一次尝试以十一株幼苗死亡告终。（result in）
由于那次失败，我们重写了整个实验方案。（as a result of）
第二组数据整齐得令人不敢相信。（results）
大多数失败都源于糟糕的实验设计。（result from）
我们同时改动了两个变量，因此一切都失去了意义。（as a result）
最后我们只写出了给校刊的一句话。（with the result that）
answers: Our first attempt resulted in eleven dead seedlings.
As a result of that failure we rewrote the whole experiment.
The second set of results was too regular to believe.
Most failures result from bad experimental design.
We changed two variables at once, and as a result nothing we did meant anything.
We worked for six weeks, with the result that we produced one sentence for the school magazine.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 result 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: We wrote a hypothesis down before we had any idea how to test it, and our first attempt resulted in eleven dead seedlings.
As a result of that failure we changed only the temperature, and the second set of results was far more regular.
Failures usually result from bad design rather than bad luck, since two moving variables destroy any honest evidence.
As a result we learned to record every measurement twice, and our final result was modest but true.
When the science fair results appeared, ours came fourth, which taught me that the result itself is rarely the interesting part.
The discipline of asking one question at a time is simple, with the result that even a dull experiment can teach you a method.
